name: stillos-notary-mcp
description: Independent attestation infrastructure for the agentic economy. Every claim is cryptographically signed (Ed25519) and settled against verifiable external ground truth — on-chain state, GitHub, market data, or structured API responses — producing an audit-grade, independently re-verifiable receipt with no reliance on counterparty trust. Complimentary tier, no account required, engineered fail-closed.
